races.paceDynamic: Norwalk Havoc (non-runner) removes one front-runner, leaving Clouds Hill as the sole confirmed pace-setter with support from prominent runners Respond, Callianassa, and Whip Cracker. This creates a moderate gallop rather than a fierce battle, with the large field of hold-up horses (Auld Toon Loon, El Burhan, Great David, Bragbor, Triple Double A, Bravais, Janey Mackers, Echalar) tracking behind. The pace will be honest but not punishing through the first six furlongs, then intensify as the prominent racers press forward approaching the home turn. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up merchants who can unleash late runs, as they'll benefit from the moderate early gallop and strong finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate through halfway with Clouds Hill setting sensible fractions
scenarios.body: The large contingent of closers will have plenty left for sustained finishing kicks, overwhelming the pace-setters in the final two furlongs. Horses like El Burhan and Great David with proven finishing speed will thrive off this setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Respond and Whip Cracker apply early pressure to Clouds Hill, creating stronger fractions
scenarios.body: The increased pace will stretch the field and favour horses positioned prominently who can maintain momentum without expending energy from the back. Ryan Moore's tactical awareness on Whip Cracker becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Clouds Hill Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Clouds Hill gets an uncontested lead with soft fractions through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The Charlie Johnston-trained leader can dictate terms completely, saving energy for a decisive kick when challenged late. His recent Goodwood win shows he can capitalize on tactical advantages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the moderate early pace becomes crawling, turning into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of instant acceleration rather than sustained speed, suiting horses with sharp turn of foot regardless of position. This chaotic finish could produce a surprise winner.

watchPoints.text: Clouds Hill must handle the responsibility as lone pace-setter after Norwalk Havoc's withdrawal creates tactical pressure
El Burhan's finishing kick will be crucial to monitor - his Goodwood acceleration suggests he's the main pace beneficiary
Ryan Moore's position choice on Whip Cracker will signal whether prominent tactics can succeed against the closers
Great David's fitness after 258-day layoff despite James Tate's typically ready runners from breaks
The 122lb-138lb weight spread means horses like Triple Double A and Echalar carry significant advantages at the finish

races.paceDynamic: Joulany and Distorted Truth will ensure strong early pace from the off, with both confirmed front-runners likely to dispute the lead through Chester's testing turns. This honest gallop will stretch the field and create a genuine test of stamina over this extended mile and a half. The strong pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to finish strongly, as the early leaders face pressure throughout. This race shape clearly favours closers and hold-up performers who can capitalize on the expected pace collapse.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Capitalize Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle between Joulany and Distorted Truth creates genuine early pressure
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will stretch the field and allow the hold-up horses to pick off tiring leaders in the final furlong. Galiyan and Glory Of The Seas are best positioned to benefit from this strong pace setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders manages to steal a decisive advantage and control the tempo
scenarios.body: Either Joulany or Distorted Truth could dominate if they avoid a sustained pace duel and dictate terms. The class advantage of Joulany makes him most likely to benefit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners compromise each other through overly aggressive early tactics
scenarios.body: A completely false pace could develop if the leaders burn out quickly, favoring those tracking just behind. Take A Chill Pill's prominent style could prove ideal in these circumstances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners are restrained and create an unexpectedly slow tempo
scenarios.body: A sprint finish from the entire field could develop if tactical riding prevails over natural pace. This would bring stamina doubts into play and favor horses with proven finishing kicks.

races.paceDynamic: A Piece Of Heaven will set a sustainable pace from the front without pressure, as no other confirmed front-runners are in this field. The prominent racers Spirit Mixer, Maxi King, Chemistry, and Berkshire Sundance will track within striking distance, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Zanndabad, Moon Over Miami, Galileo Dame, and Aimeric will be positioned towards the rear. With Chester's tight turns and long straight, the moderate early pace will allow the hold-up horses to mount their challenges, but they'll need to navigate traffic in a large field. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can position close to the pace and avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will befall the back-markers.

scenarios.body: The sustainable gallop suits the front-runner perfectly and he has enough left to resist late challenges. Team Player's recent form suggests he could be the main danger from off the pace.

scenarios.title: Outsider strikes

scenarios.body: Puturhandstogether benefits from the O'Brien stable's excellent recent form and his prominent style suits this race shape. Alphonse Le Grande's fresh appearance could catch others napping.

The large field of hold-up horses including Clonmacash, Kirkdale, The Good Biscuit, and Secret Guest will rely on the pace being strong enough to set up their finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can track the early pace and strike approaching the final furlong, as they avoid both the pressure on the leader and the traffic concerns facing the hold-up brigade.

scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur goes too fast early or the prominent pack gets into a speed duel
scenarios.body: The early pace collapses in the final furlong, allowing the patient hold-up horses to unleash telling finishes down the Chester straight. The best finishers with proven course form can exploit the setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Rosenpur gets an uncontested lead and the field allows him soft fractions
scenarios.body: With no serious pace pressure early, Rosenpur can dictate terms and kick clear approaching the final 2f before the chasers can respond. His recent good form suggests he can sustain a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If multiple prominent runners press Rosenpur early creating unsustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The early speed horses tie up badly in the final furlong, creating a messy finish where any horse with a late kick can capitalise on the carnage ahead. The longest-priced hold-up horses could sneak through.

Behind them, six prominent racers (Temple Of Athena, Exclamation, One And Gone, Schrodinger's Cat, Inca Heights, Kolkata Knight, Wyle Cop) will create significant traffic congestion approaching the 2f marker, with several forced to check or switch. The tactical advantage clearly favours the hold-up horses (Champonie, Watcha Snoop, Proof, Alvin, Henrythenate) who can avoid the early scrimmaging and benefit from the honest gallop set by the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group gets into traffic trouble 2f out as expected
scenarios.body: The honest pace set by Arlo's Girl and Ambishio perfectly sets up the race for the closers who can pick off the faltering prominent runners. Champonie, Proof, and Alvin have the class and tactical positioning to exploit this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front two collapse late
scenarios.trigger: If both Arlo's Girl and Ambishio fade in the final furlong after setting the pace
scenarios.body: The prominent group benefits as traffic clears, with Schrodinger's Cat and Kolkata Knight having the form and finishing kick to capitalize. Temple Of Athena's Chester course form makes her dangerous in this setup.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Wire-to-wire winner emerges
scenarios.trigger: If one of the leaders maintains their kick to the line despite the honest gallop
scenarios.body: Arlo's Girl has the most natural speed and her 98-day break could have her primed for a bold front-running performance. The honest pace may not be strong enough to stop a classy leader with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If the early fractions are slower than expected with both leaders conserving energy
scenarios.body: This creates a messy sprint finish where any style can win, favoring horses with natural gate speed like Temple Of Athena. The prominent group gets the best of both worlds - position without traffic trouble.

races.paceDynamic: Imperial Trooper will be the lone leader from the start and sets a solid but not pressured pace around Chester's tight circuit. The prominent runners Sportingsilvermine, Siouxfonic, L'Eagle Aid and Wise Counsellor will track him through the early stages but none are aggressive early types. With only one confirmed front-runner and a field heavy on hold-up horses like Patagonia Girl, Secret Beach, Nightsinwhitesatin and Maasai Mara, this creates a tactical race with plenty of cover. This pace setup strongly favours prominent horses who can track the leader and kick clear, as the hold-up brigade may find too much traffic on Chester's narrow home straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Victory
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Trooper sets steady fractions and the prominent horses get first run
scenarios.body: The trackers get ideal positioning behind the lone leader and have enough left to outstay him in the straight. Hold-up horses struggle for clear runs in a slowly-run race where the pace doesn't collapse.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens mid-race or the prominent horses go too hard tracking Imperial Trooper
scenarios.body: The early speed collapses in the final two furlongs allowing the closers to sweep past. Patagonia Girl and Nightsinwhitesatin benefit from their superior recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Imperial Trooper Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If no horse seriously challenges Imperial Trooper through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The leader gets an uncontested lead and has enough left to repel late challengers on a track that can favour front-runners. His recent third at Goodwood suggests he retains ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos in Running
scenarios.trigger: If traffic problems or interference occur in Chester's tight straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with hold-up horses blocked and prominent runners having nowhere to go. An outsider who gets a clear run benefits from the messy pace.
